'''Eaden Vrill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who served as [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] on [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]. Along with the rest of the crew Vrill was hired to protect [[Javul Charn]] from her stalker. Vrill was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] called [[Edge (Anomid)|Edge]] sent after Charn by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="you choose">{{Suvudu|subdomain=star-wars|url=2010/10/choose_next_star_wars_title.html|text=You Choose the Next Star Wars Title!|date=2010-10-04}}</ref> Vrill was a known practitioner of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]], and a member of [[Sälãi Käsi]] until it was disbanded by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] because its members were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Only two members of this group remained.<ref name="SG" />
